major_cooldowns.name: Bestial Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown as your only cooldown, and time your first Kill Command right after it to trigger its hero-talent proc (a Stampede for Pack Leader, or a Black Arrow proc that later becomes Wailing Arrow for Dark Ranger).

defensives.name: Aspect of the Turtle
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for a hit that would otherwise kill you or a heavy unavoidable raid mechanic.

defensives.name: Survival of the Fittest
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into telegraphed raid damage; its shorter cooldown means you can use it more freely than Aspect of the Turtle.

defensives.name: Exhilaration
defensives.usage_rule: Use it after taking a chunk of damage to top yourself and your pet back up.

rules.description: Open with Barbed Shot into Bestial Wrath
rules.action: Fire a Barbed Shot first, follow with Bestial Wrath, then spend Kill Command.

rules.description: Bank a Kill Command charge for Bestial Wrath
rules.action: Hold a Kill Command charge rather than spending it when Bestial Wrath is about to come off cooldown, so you can weave it in right after the cooldown lands.
